title: Chopchinyadi Churna
description: Chopchinyadi Churna is formulated with Chopchini (Smilax china), a premier blood-purifying and alterative herb used for skin conditions. This classical formulation manages chronic skin conditions like psoriasis (autoimmune skin disease with plaques) and eczema (inflammatory skin disease with itching) through deep blood cleansing. Treats venereal diseases (sexually transmitted infections) with manifestations in skin and systemic symptoms. Provides immense relief in gouty arthritis through uric acid reduction and inflammation management.
